title: Clinical Procedures to Support Research in ALS
brief_summary: The purpose of the Clinical Procedures To Support Research (CAPTURE) study is to utilize information collected in the medical record to learn more about a disease called amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and related disorders.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of ALS or a related disorder (e.g. primary lateral sclerosis, progressive muscular atrophy).
* Receiving care at a clinical center that uses Epic as its EHR.
* Able and willing to provide informed consent (or informed consent obtainable from a designated proxy).

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to understand English and/or Spanish
study_population: Affected patients receiving care at a clinical center that uses Epic as EHR.
